title: Return of the CHAMPs: A clockwork portal to charged dark matter
summary: While Dark Matter (DM) is conventionally assumed to be chargeless, the possibility of a charged massive particle (CHAMP) as the DM particle remains alive. With phenomenological constraints on the charge being very severe, such a scenario is often sought to be dismissed, citing naturalness. Moreover, the establishment of the correct relic density is often a concern. We demonstrate here that such a (mini)charged DM can yet be realized within the clockwork paradigm, without the need to invoke unnaturally small parameters. The model is examined against constraints, theoretical and experimental,…
